info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Channel Specific By Param1-spec
info.description: The Channel-Specific Branch Location Management API allows businesses to retrieve detailed information about branch locations based on specific channel parameters. This API serves financial institutions and retail organizations looking to enhance their geographic service offerings or optimize branch performance. Typical use cases include querying branch information for marketing campaigns, analyzing distribution channels, or improving customer service by providing targeted location data. Users can leverage this API to facilitate strategic decision-making related to branch locations.

get.summary: Retrieve branch location details by resource ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific branch location using its unique resource ID (RES-100045). This is useful for obtaining location-specific data, managing branch information, or integrating with other services that require location details.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters for fetching the specific branch location details for the given channel. Ensure that all required fields are populated correctly to achieve a successful response.
